headline: Sensex and Nifty Rally Led by Foreign Fund Inflows, Lower Crude Prices, and Banking Stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign fund inflows (FIIs) boosted investor confidence across Indian equity markets.
Lower crude oil prices helped reduce cost pressures and supported market sentiment.
Early trading rebound was driven by gains in financial and banking stocks.
Sectoral rotation and foreign flow optimism contributed to gains in Sensex and Nifty.
whatHappening: HAL reported a 16% increase in Q2 net profit to Rs 1,936 crore, beating estimates.
Bharat Dynamics shares fell over 6% following a 15% drop in Q2 profit and narrowed margins.
Alkem Laboratories posted a 12% decline in Q2 net profit to Rs 675 crore and named a new CFO.
Bharat Forge's subsidiary KSSL unveiled a new 120mm rapid attack mortar system for defense forces.
summary: Indian equity markets traded higher supported by foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices, and strength in banking stocks. In corporate earnings news, HAL beat profit estimates while Bharat Dynamics and Alkem Laboratories reported lower Q2 net profits. Additionally, Bharat Forge's defense subsidiary unveiled a new mortar system.
